task.text: Marisol, I hope you are doing well. The client contacted me to ask whether you can stamp the changes without redlines, possibly by adding a letter describing the change you are approving. Is that feasible? If it is, I can send you the formal offer. Please also resend the PE name and license number, because I am seeing different information for Nevada PE license 47283 on the PE website. Thanks, Kieran.
